headline: TVS ILP launches year-round wellbeing programme for employees
summary: TVS Industrial & Logistics Parks has introduced the People Happiness Programme, a year-round employee wellbeing initiative spanning physical, psychological, social, and financial health. The continuous program offers resources such as health check-ups, 24/7 counseling, team offsites, and financial planning support. The company plans to refine the program through ongoing employee pulse checks and feedback as it scales operations across India.

headline: AI reshapes banking: DNB to cut 400 jobs in tech overhaul
summary: Norwegian lender DNB plans to eliminate approximately 400 jobs from its Technology & Services division by the end of 2026 as it transitions toward AI-driven automation. The restructuring aims to boost efficiency and accelerate operations, following similar AI-related workforce reductions by global peers like Visa and Standard Chartered. DNB's stock rose slightly following the announcement, reflecting investor confidence in the bank's digital strategy.
